relationships.subject: PSPD2003
relationships.evidence_quote: PSPD2003 increased spinal TLR4 expression, elevated TNF-α and IL-6 levels and promoted activation of dorsal horn microglia

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: demonstrating that TLR4 signalling is essential for PSPD2003-induced pain

relationships.subject: LPS-RS
relationships.evidence_quote: the nociceptive responses elicited by the peptides were effectively reversed by prior intrathecal administration of the TLR4 antagonist LPS‐RS

key_findings: Intrathecal SARS-CoV-2 spike peptides (esp. PSPD2003) induce mechanical nociception abolished in TLR4-/- mice.
PSPD2003 acts via TLR4-dependent microglial activation and p38 MAPK/NF-kB signalling.
